1:1.note: bismi: 'in the name of' - bi- (preposition) + ism (noun); the noun is majrūr (genitive) after the preposition.
Allāh: the divine name; majrūr (genitive) here because it follows a preposition.
ar-raḥīmi: 'the Most Merciful' - definite adjective; majrūr (genitive), matching ar-raḥmāni.

1:2.note: al-ḥamdu: 'the praise / all praise' - definite noun; subject (mubtadaʾ) of the sentence, marfūʿ (nominative) with ḍammah.
li-llāhi: 'belongs to Allāh' - preposition li- + the divine name; majrūr (genitive).
rabbi: 'lord of' - first term of an iḍāfa (possessive construction) with al-ʿālamīn; majrūr (genitive).
al-ʿālamīna: 'the worlds / all creation' - second term of the iḍāfa; majrūr (genitive), plural ending -īn(a).

112:1.note: aḥadun: 'one' - predicate (khabar) of the sentence; marfūʿ (nominative) with tanwīn.

112:2.note: Allāhu: 'Allah' - definite noun; marfūʿ (nominative), subject of the sentence.
aṣ-ṣamadu: 'the Eternal / the Self-Sufficient' - definite noun; predicate (khabar), marfūʿ (nominative).

103:1.note: wal-ʿaṣri: 'by the time / by the afternoon' - wa- (oath particle 'by') + al-ʿaṣr (definite noun, majrūr / genitive in the oath).

114:1.note: aʿūdhu: 'I seek refuge' - present-tense verb (fiʿl muḍāriʿ), first person singular.
